title: EZLN Says the Three Levels of Government Are Trying to Prevent It From Meeting With Searching Mothers in Mexico City
author: Elio Henríquez
content:
_This article by[Elio
Henríquez](https://www.jornada.com.mx/autores/Elio%20Henr%C3%ADquez,%20corresponsal)
originally appeared in the [November 2, 2026 edition of La
Jornada](https://www.jornada.com.mx/noticia/2026/11/02/estados/ezln-senala-
que-los-tres-ordenes-de-gobierno-intentan-impedir-que-se-reuna-con-madres-
buscadoras-en-cdmx), Mexico's premier left wing daily newspaper._

**San Cristóbal de Las Casas, Chiapas**. The Zapatista Army of National
Liberation (EZLN) stated that the federal government, the Chiapas state
government and various municipal governments have undertaken various
“provocations” to prevent **a delegation of 1,530 of its members** from
traveling to Mexico City to meet in December with searching mothers.

“They are playing with fire. The embrace for the searching mothers is a civil
and peaceful initiative. It does not seek to confront anyone,” the EZLN
maintained, while stressing:

> We are going to go. Whether they like it or not, we are going to go.
>
> EZLN

In a communiqué signed by Subcomandante Moisés and by the Assembly of
Collectives of Zapatista Autonomous Governments (A.C.G.A.Z.) and Common
Governments of the 12 Zapatista Caracoles, the EZLN recalled that “in July of
this year, we announced our intention to travel to Mexico City to meet with
groups, collectives, and families without a group, of Searching Family
Members. Not for assemblies, not to create new networks or coordinating
bodies, but to listen, group by group, family by family, to their stories and
the stories of their absent ones. And also, if they accept it, to give them an
embrace sent by the Zapatista communities.”

It said that “we named Mexico City as the central venue to spare the families
with absent ones the wear and expense that coming all the way to Zapatista
territory would have meant,” but “since then, the federal government, the
Chiapas state government and various municipal governments have carried out a
series of actions that not only violate human rights (not only of Zapatistas,
but also of party members and those without a party), they also contradict the
discourse of peace, happiness and well-being that they preach up there.”

It stressed that “**the simplest way to prevent us from going to Mexico City
is to satisfy the demand for truth and justice** of those who have lost their
loved ones to unnatural causes. That way those searching families will tell
us: don’t come anymore, we are satisfied.”

It added: “Bring thousands and tens of thousands of armies. Explain to the
troops and to society that they are going to try to stop a mobilization that
aims to give an embrace and listen to the pain of others. What we are going to
do is called ‘empathy,’ something they apparently lack.”

It stated that “up there, at the federal, state and municipal level, they have
to understand that we are going to go (it may be that some of ours are already
there) to Mexico City, we are going to meet with the searching families who
want to and can in Mexico City, in Veracruz, in Puebla, in Jalisco, in Oaxaca
and in Querétaro; we are going to listen to the story of their pain; we are
going to embrace them; we are going to keep their word in our _morraletas_ ;
we are going to bring their stories back and we are going to keep them so that
oblivion and indifference do not stain them.”

It noted that “any provocation will be answered with force and mobilization.
They have to decide whether they accept that fact and settle for us keeping
our word. Or they can continue with their blunders (in which the entire
federal and state cabinet and the municipal presidencies are involved) and
give our initiative a different character. We are not going to make noise, but
we can.”

Regarding the “provocations,” the EZLN detailed that “in the La Culebra ejido,
in the official municipality of Ocosingo (governed by the Ecologist Green
Party of Mexico), they continue to harass, threaten and jail families who are
support bases. Those who provoke there are members of the Cartel of Mario
Delgado, federal Secretary of Public Education. The main hitman is Eusebio
Cruz Ruiz, who presents himself as a teacher and who says he receives direct
orders from Mario Delgado.”

It pointed out that “now they have gone a step further by prohibiting everyone
from going to the compas’ cooperative store under penalty of jail. And, also,
that any resident of that ejido or of nearby communities who is treated at the
common clinic (which serves Zapatistas, party members and those without a
party), will be jailed and fined. Whoever does not obey is taken prisoner.”

It asserted that “we are not making this up” and “in addition to prohibiting
free transit, free trade and access to health care, they ‘respectfully’ put in
jail and fine whoever does not obey them, not only in the ejido, but in all
the surrounding communities.”

It stated that “on the so-called San Cristóbal–Palenque highway, which is a
federal project, the National Guard, the State Police, the municipal police
and the landowner named Audamaro Oropeza Camacho destroyed Common property on
land recovered more than 32 years ago, knocked down the signs indicating that
this land was part of the Good Government Council and now belongs to the
Common; they stole cattle from the Common, deliberately destroyed milpas and
forests, with the support and approval of the municipal and state authorities
of Chiapas.”

The complaints, it said, “have already been made before Frayba (Fray Bartolomé
de Las Casas Human Rights Center) several times, and it already presented them
to federal and state authorities **without there being any response, neither
in word nor in action**.”

It concluded: “Whatever is going to happen, say publicly that it will be to
satisfy a hitman of Mario Delgado, so that a landowner, Audomaro Oropeza
Camacho, can steal more cattle and land from the Zapatista Indigenous people,
and to impose a highway that is rejected by all the original inhabitants of
the area. There you have it. Forewarned is forearmed.”
